Local-first, bring your own models."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Infinite Canvas for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A node-based short-drama studio inside DeepSeek Harness.** Start from a one-line idea, walk out wi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"th a storyboarded, voiced, subtitled video cut — right on an infinite canvas."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 简体中文 · **User guide: English** · 操作手册（中文）"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What is this?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Infinite Canvas is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the web GUI's sidebar into a full creation s"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tudio. Every node is an AI workbench, and the **chat side is the "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"director**: ask in plain language and the agent operates the canvas tools for you — batch work espec"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"or**: ask in plain language and the agent operates the canvas tools for you — batch work especially."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> *"Create a project called Time-Postman, write the world view and series bible first."*

| **Genre** | 36 narrative / 10 sector | Pressure mechanics, audience pa"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"yoff, scene granules, episode hooks | The same "revenge" premise is fragmented neon under Wong Kar-w"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ai and hard-lit slow motion under Tsui Hark; folding them together poisons both |
| **Spec** | 8 | S"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"tructure blocks, ASL floor, rhythm, quality bar | It decides "short drama vs cinematic texture vs co"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"mmercial", which is orthogonal to genre |
| **Look** | 9 | Imaging base, material, render texture | "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"2D thick paint / guoman 3D / game CG are imaging domains, not directors; mixing them into the direct"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"or layer makes "how to cut" fight "what it looks like" |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Directors (45)**: Chinese 16 (Wong Kar-wai, Zhang Yimou, Hou Hsiao-hsien, Bi Gan, Tsui Hark, Lu Ya"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ng, Yuen Woo-ping, Wu Ershan, Ang Lee, Edward Yang, Jia Zhangke, Jiang Wen, Johnnie To, Ning Hao, St"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ephen Chow, Wong Jing) · Japan/Korea 7 (Kurosawa, Park Chan-wook, Bong Joon-ho, Kore-eda Hirokazu, L"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ee Chang-dong, Miyazaki Hayao, Shinkai Makoto) · Western 22 (Spielberg, Hitchcock, Kubrick, Scorsese"},{"id":"p20s5","text":", Fellini, Bergman, Tarkovsky, Nolan, Villeneuve, Fincher, Refn, Malick, Michael Mann, Coen Brothers"},{"id":"p20s6","text":", Ridley Scott, David Lynch, Alfonso Cuarón, Iñárritu, Wes Anderson, George Miller, Almodóvar, Guy R"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" Scott, David Lynch, Alfonso Cuarón, Iñárritu, Wes Anderson, George Miller, Almodóvar, Guy Ritchie)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Specs (8)**: Short drama · Cinematic texture · Commercial · Documentary · Music video · Trailer · "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"Explainer · Interview."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- A **short drama** is a self-contained 60–180 s unit and **covers both single episodes and multi-ep"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"isode series** — a series is just episode after episode, so there is no separate "series" form.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Data & privacy"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Canvas documents, projects and settings live in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-ic:*`); asset metadat"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"a lives in IndexedDB (`dsh-infinite-canvas`) while media files persist **on disk** once a data root "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"is set (per-project folders by project name, served by the plugin backend with HTTP Range support fo"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"r video seeking).
- AI text generation runs through the Harness host process (your configured models"},{"id":"p26s5","text":", no extra keys).
- Image/video/TTS gateway calls are relayed by the local Harness host process (avo"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ids browser CORS limits); your endpoints and keys stay local.
- Nothing is uploaded anywhere by the "},{"id":"p26s7","text":"RS limits); your endpoints and keys stay local.
- Nothing is uploaded anywhere by the plugin itself."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Requirements & limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+; demo video export needs MediaRecorder (Chromium).

- Image `edits`/mask inpainting requires a model that supports the endpoint (e.g. gpt-ima"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ge-1).
- Host-side plugin updates need one Harness restart; the web half hot-reloads."}],"truncated":true}
